Circular No. TEST/COE/2026/11        Date: 25 August 2026
Subject: Revised floor for attendance after relaxation

1. In supersession of clause 11.6 of the B.Tech Regulations, a student shall not be permitted to appear in the MSE/ESE if his/her attendance is below 65% after all relaxations, with effect from 1 September 2026.
2. All other provisions remain unchanged.
